_schema.purpose: Persistent stand-down registry: tools/packages/repos/actions the operator has explicitly said NOT to install/run/integrate. Machine-checkable before any install, MCP add, or settings edit via a check_standdown script. A persistent registry beats a message-level reminder because it survives across sessions and processes.

entry_shape.kind: package | repo | command | mcp | url | pattern
entry_shape.target: what to match against (package name, repo URL, or a command/regex when kind=pattern)
entry_shape.expires_at: ISO date, or null for permanent
re_audit_triggers: conditions that should re-open evaluation, or 'never'
entry_shape.source_decision: path to a memory/Decisions.md entry or audit memo (optional)

lookup_rules: Exact/substring match on target preferred. Regex matching only when kind=pattern.
If severity=block: refuse to proceed, surface the reason to the operator.
If severity=warn: proceed only with explicit operator re-confirmation citing the reason.
If expires_at is in the past: treat as expired and re-evaluate (do NOT auto-allow). Surface as expired-needs-review.
Any short-name-installable tool needs TWO entries: a descriptive one AND a kind=pattern bare-name guard, because a repo-URL target does not match a bare-name install.

entries.reason: Fabricated example entry. Anonymous maintainer + inorganic star pattern flagged during audit. Do not re-audit.
Never pipe a downloaded script straight into a shell. Read it first. This is a standing pattern-block, not a one-off.
Never install/run any repo less than 7 days old. New repos have not been community-vetted. The check script resolves repo age and matches this sentinel.
